location: Naracoorte, Limestone Coast, South Australia, Australia

main_turf.surface: Turf (Kikuyu grass on loam soil base)
main_turf.bias_notes: Anti-clockwise (left-handed). Situated in the Limestone Coast region of South Australia near the Victorian border. A 1,720m undulating turf oval featuring a short 320m home straight. The short run-in creates a distinct advantage for tactical, on-pace runners ('E' and 'P' styles) who can settle in the first four before turning for home. Deep closers ('C') struggle down the short 320m stretch unless early pace is frantic.
main_turf.post_bias: INSIDE BARRIER EDGE: Inside barriers (stalls 1–4) offer a noticeable advantage in sprint trips up to 1200m due to the short run to the first turn. Wide draws (8+) over 1000m and 1200m are penalizing unless the runner possesses enough early speed to cross cleanly.

handicapping_angles.naracoorte_cup_february_feature: The Naracoorte Cup ($40k+ Handicap, 2000m, February) is the marquee event of the Naracoorte Racing Club. Attracts Adelaide metropolitan and Western Victorian country stables. Upgrade horses with proven Limestone Coast form (+2.5 pts).
handicapping_angles.victorian_border_and_adelaide_shippers: Naracoorte receives high-volume shippers from Western Victorian country tracks (Warrnambool, Casterton, Hamilton, Horsham) and Adelaide metro yards (e.g. Sue & Jason Jaensch, Tom Dabernig, Symon Wilde, Paul Preusker). Upgrade Victorian provincial/metro drop-down shippers (+3.0 pts).
handicapping_angles.limestone_coast_circuit_form: Form translates seamlessly between Naracoorte, Mount Gambier, Penola, Bordertown, and Millicent. Horses with proven wins across the Limestone Coast circuit hold a distinct track-suitability edge.
handicapping_angles.short_320m_straight_pace_bias: Tactical pressers ('P') holding the fence entering the 320m home stretch win over 68% of races. Downgrade deep back-markers ('C') unless early speed is contested.
